nodes.label: Layered Architecture
nodes.rationale: One-directional dependency flow (ui -> application -> core -> services -> systems -> models/data); high-level layers depend on lower ones, never the reverse, and the UI is fully replaceable.

nodes.label: UI Decoupling
nodes.rationale: Coupling game rules to presentation is the most common reason a prototype cannot grow; forbidding UI concerns in the core gives portability, testability, parallel development, and determinism.

nodes.label: Gold / Spirit Stones
nodes.rationale: Shops spend Gold (player.gold) or Spirit Stones (spirit_stone inventory items); purchasing never auto-equips.

nodes.label: Encounter Pools
nodes.rationale: encounter_pools.json maps a location to weighted combat/loot/special pools; locations without a pool fall back to global events.json pools.

nodes.label: Location Schema
nodes.rationale: Node-based locations with map_position (0..1), connected_locations, requirements, danger_level, qi_density, npc_ids and available_systems.

nodes.label: Cultivation Gating
nodes.rationale: TravelService blocks travel by realm minimums, required items and reputation, returning reason codes such as BODY_REALM_TOO_LOW and NO_ROUTE.

nodes.label: Travel Graph
nodes.rationale: Data-driven node-based travel graph on the Sky Spill Continent; locations store connected_locations and map_position.

nodes.label: Effective Stats / Passive Skills
nodes.rationale: Always-on passives are applied on demand by StatsSystem.effective_stats so base stats stay pristine and a passive can never double-apply across save/load.

nodes.label: Derived Equipment Stats
nodes.rationale: Equipment contributes through StatsSystem.effective_stats(); base player stats are never mutated by equipping.

nodes.label: Equipment Slots
nodes.rationale: 11 persistent slots: weapon, armor, boots, cloak, ring_1/2, amulet, talisman, artifact_1/2, flying_sword.

nodes.label: EventType Contract
nodes.rationale: Every result dict carries an 'event' key (an EventType) the UI uses to choose a formatter; results carry structured data, never formatted text.

nodes.label: Central Validation
nodes.rationale: validate_all_game_data() cross-references every ID and rule and is exercised by test_all_game_data_valid.py.

nodes.label: Rarity Ladder
nodes.rationale: Canonical 7-grade ladder mortal_grade -> low/middle/high_spirit_grade -> earth/heaven_grade -> dao_grade; caps exploration find rarity by danger_level.

nodes.label: Cultivation Save Shape
nodes.rationale: Both tracks serialized separately via CultivationState.to_dict()/from_dict() using stable realm IDs, strain and foundation_stability.

nodes.label: Save Version
nodes.rationale: Schema version 2; version-1 saves (Spiritual Root / Physique fields) are rejected on load.

nodes.label: Lifespan
nodes.rationale: Characters start at age 12; time-consuming actions advance age by data-driven costs; max lifespan follows the current Essence realm.

nodes.label: Starting Fate
nodes.rationale: New games roll independent Martial and Body talents; only stable IDs are saved and views are read-only.

nodes.label: Talent Ladder
nodes.rationale: Data-driven 20 tiers + Apex (tier 21); one shared index resolves both Martial and Body talent names, the reachable realm, and max_lifespan_years.

nodes.label: Breakthrough Gating
nodes.rationale: Breakthroughs check progress, foundation, resources, injury, strain and stability; failures return stable codes such as STRAIN_TOO_HIGH and FOUNDATION_UNSTABLE.

nodes.label: Cultivation Strain
nodes.rationale: Per-track fatigue built by training; breakthroughs are gated by max_strain_for_breakthrough (body) and the essence_progression block.

nodes.label: Foundation Stability
nodes.rationale: Starts at 100; failed breakthroughs lower it and must be restored via stabilise actions before further breakthroughs.

nodes.label: Engine Contract
nodes.rationale: The core exposes only process_action() and get_game_state() (plus is_running() and set_player_name()) so every frontend depends on one stable interface.

nodes.label: Engine State Ownership
nodes.rationale: GameEngine is the single owner of mutable session state (Player, mode, current Enemy, cooldowns, running flag); systems are stateless with respect to the session.

nodes.label: Phase 2 - Alpha (depth + breadth)
nodes.rationale: Full campaign, living world, full dao system, rich meta unlocks, broad content base. Not started.

nodes.label: Phase 3 - 1.0 (balance + polish)
nodes.rationale: Simulation-tuned balance, prose quality pass, full Godot UX, release docs. Not started.

nodes.label: Phase 4 - Endless (stretch)
nodes.rationale: Expansions, challenge modes, achievements, optional LLM dialogue layer. Not started.

nodes.label: GameEngine split into core/engine/ mixins
nodes.rationale: game_engine.py was refactored into nine mixins (combat, dispatch, economy, exploration, lifecycle, progression, social, systems, views) to tame a monolithic orchestrator.

nodes.label: Phase 1 - MVP (core loop sings)
nodes.rationale: Complete replayable vertical slice: Act 1 story, dao combat, procedural prose, permadeath + one meta unlock, one procedural secret realm. DONE 2026-08-14.
